title: Ordinary coefficient reduction preserves the pullback tensor comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, system operations o [def-sf-integral-system-operations], a normalized realization model m and ringed tensor models d [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. For any scheme morphism f:U→V and arbitrary ordinary completed-ring derived objects K,H on V, let R be whole-system coefficient reduction and delta_f the specified reduction/pullback comparison. Let mu_W be R_W applied to the tensorClosed identification followed by reductionTensor_W, tau_sys the canonical system pullback/tensor comparison, and tau_ring its independently normalized ordinary ringed counterpart. Then delta_f(T_V(K,H)) followed by P_sys(f)(mu_V(K,H)) and tau_sys(RK,RH) equals R_U(tau_ring(K,H)) followed by mu_U(P_ring(f)K,P_ring(f)H) and tensor(delta_f(K),delta_f(H)). This is an equality of whole-system derived arrows with the actual quotient transitions, without any expression, child coefficient maps, completion or finite-type hypotheses.

theorem canonicalReductionTensorPull
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (o : Operations l E) (m : RealizationModel l E o) (d : RingedModels l E)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ V) (K H : Integral l E V) :
    let μ (W : Scheme.{u}) :
        (d.tensor W).ordinary.tensor ⋙ (calculus l E W).reduction ⟶
          (calculus l E W).reduction.prod (calculus l E W).reduction ⋙
            (calculus l E W).systemClosed.tensor :=
      Functor.whiskerRight (eqToIso (d.tensorClosed W)).hom (calculus l E W).reduction ≫
        (calculus l E W).reductionTensor.hom
    (m.reductionPull f).hom.app ((d.tensor V).ordinary.tensor.obj (K, H)) ≫
        (pull l E f).map ((μ V).app (K, H)) ≫
        (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app
          ((calculus l E V).reduction.obj K, (calculus l E V).reduction.obj H) =
      (calculus l E U).reduction.map ((ringedTensorPull l E d f).hom.app (K, H)) ≫
        (μ U).app ((ringedPull l E f).obj K, (ringedPull l E f).obj H) ≫
        (calculus l E U).systemClosed.tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom ((m.reductionPull f).hom.app K) ((m.reductionPull f).hom.app H))
